description: The Prompt Registry manages prompt template versioning with diff comparison, and canary A/B test deployments that split traffic between baseline and candidate prompt versions to evaluate performance via statistical analysis. Backend: 6 prompt version endpoints, PromptTemplateVersion model with SHA256 content hashing, PromptTemplateCanary in SQLite+PG with proportion_analysis statistics.

architecture.backend: 6 prompt version endpoints, PromptTemplateVersion model, SHA256 content hashing
architecture.canary: PromptTemplateCanary in SQLite+PG, auto traffic routing in pipeline loop, proportion_analysis statistics
architecture.dataFlow: PromptRegistryTab -> 'Version History' button -> PromptVersionHistory -> usePromptVersions hook -> web API
architecture.canaryFlow: Create canary -> pipeline executes -> should_use_candidate() routes -> record_canary_outcome() -> evaluate_prompt_canary() with p-value

groups.name: Version History List

Each version row shows the version number badge (v1, v2...), the change description, a truncated SHA256 content hash, and the creation date. The list header displays a count of versions and provides Compare and Refresh controls. In compare mode, two versions can be selected as A and B with highlighted selection indicators.

groups.name: Canary A/B Testing
groups.description: The PromptCanaryPanel displays active and completed prompt canary A/B tests. Each canary card shows the status badge, template ID, version comparison (baseline vs candidate), traffic percentage, and a metrics comparison grid with Success Rate, Avg Cost, Avg Latency, and Delta columns. Statistical evaluation shows the p-value, verdict (promote/rollback/keep/pending), and total runs. Active canaries display a progress bar toward the minimum 20 candidate runs needed for a verdict.
